dialect: MySQL (SQLParserEngine and SQLVisitorEngine with databaseType "MySQL", visitor type STATEMENT)
parser_family: Apache ShardingSphere ANTLR4 dialect grammars (MySQLStatement.g4 generated into MySQLStatementParser) with ShardingSphere's statement visitors building SQLStatement segment models; independent of jOOQ, Druid, Calcite, JSqlParser and the Presto/Trino, Spark and Hive grammars
api: new SQLParserEngine("MySQL", new CacheOption(128, 1024L)).parse(local SQL text, false) -> ParseASTNode, then new SQLVisitorEngine("MySQL", "STATEMENT", false, new Properties()).visit(tree) -> SQLStatement; the harness reads SelectStatement (projections, join table segments, where, group by, order by) and InsertStatement (table, insert columns, values segments) and walks aggregation, function and literal expression segments
coverage: JaCoCo bytecode coverage of org.apache.shardingsphere:shardingsphere-sql-parser-engine, -mysql and -statement 5.3.2 org.apache.shardingsphere.sql.parser classes (ANTLR MySQLStatementParser and lexer, MySQL statement visitor, statement segments) during valid-control replay; Jazzer fuzz entry
scope: One SQL statement from local bytes decoded as strict UTF-8, parsed with the documented SQLParserEngine and turned into a SQLStatement by SQLVisitorEngine for the MySQL dialect (the MySQL grammar accepts the terminating semicolon); valid SELECT-with-join and multi-row INSERT controls only, each matching the hand-written oracle summary. The API parses one statement, so statement_count is 1 by contract. Other dialect modules and the parse-tree cache are untested.
